Identity fields stripped; original note preserved below. || Paxton 2026-09-09, REQUIREMENT: 'we dont want them to upload twice and wipe out the first. that is a requirement. it must continue to build uploads into text. ALSO it should warn them when its truncated the limit of text.' PROD DEPLOY AUTHORISED - Paxton 2026-09-09 lifted the hold ("i cannot test anymore ... they are blockers"). Verify on dev FIRST, then ship through the pipeline; prod runs develop-derived images so this is NOT a merge to main. Never hand-deploy. Cause already located: SessionList.tsx:481 onChange={e => setFiles(Array.from(e.target.files ?? []))} - a FileList holds only that dialog's picks, so a second selection discards the first. Needs: accumulate across picks, de-dupe on name+size+lastModified, per-file removal, and e.target.value='' so a removed file can be re-picked. ON THE LIMIT - TRUNCATE AND WARN, do NOT refuse: an earlier draft said refuse over-budget picks; Paxton overruled that. Keep building text into the design input, truncate at the real limit, and warn the user BEFORE session creation, naming which files were cut and how much was dropped, next to the Create Session control. Silent truncation is the failure mode - a user whose spec was quietly halved gets a build against requirements they never agreed to. Find the REAL cap (body/upload limits plus the downstream model-context ceiling the concatenated text feeds) - it is TOTAL BYTES, not a file count. Do not raise any server limit here. RULE 2: two uploaders exist - SessionList.tsx:478 and features/session/setup/SpecUploader.tsx:215 (the latter has tests). Collapse to one; do not add a third.
